app.title: Robot seller
app.tagline: For the makers of the delivery robots

language.title: Language

login.title: Log in as robot seller
login.intro: This panel is for the makers of the robots. Companies that buy robots use their own app.
login.devNote: Local demo: any password works, the email address must belong to a staff member.
